theme.title: Rotation: Growth → Value & Defensives
theme.summary: Health Care (+0.42%) and Consumer Staples (+0.20%) led the market today, while Communication Svcs (-1.58%) and Consumer Discretionary (-1.41%) brought up the rear. That split lines up with a rotation out of growth: growth-oriented sectors averaged -1.38% versus -0.10% for defensives and -0.62% for value and cyclicals, suggesting money moved from high-multiple names into steadier, cash-generative businesses. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.77%, Dow -0.67%, Nasdaq -0.92% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.69%. The VIX rose 8.07% to 16.07, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 1.75% to $4,156.50, crude oil was little changed at $93.08, and bitcoin slipped 0.06% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
